1	# frai-gate
2	
3	The **FRAI Gate** (Responsible AI Gate) for specs - part of [FRAI](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai).
4	
5	Every spec for an AI-touching feature must contain a complete `## FRAI Gate`
6	section - seven checks - and implementation doesn't start until the gate passes:
7	
8	1. Risk tier (EU AI Act-aligned; high-risk requires a named human sign-off)
9	2. Data provenance & privacy
10	3. Human oversight
11	4. Evaluation plan (numeric thresholds)
12	5. Bias & fairness
13	6. Monitoring & rollback
14	7. Transparency & incident response
15	
16	## Usage
17	
18	```bash
19	npx frai-gate init --ci                 # scaffold FRAI-SPEC.md + a GitHub Action that runs
20	                                        # the gate on every PR (works in any repo)
21	npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md         # deterministic validation - no API key needed
22	npx frai-gate check FRAI-SPEC.md --smart # + adversarial AI review of answer quality
23	npx frai-gate draft                     # read-only agent scans the repo and drafts a
24	                                        # gate section grounded in your actual code
25	```
26	
27	Also available as `frai gate ...` from the main [frai CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/frai).
28	
29	Exit codes: `0` PASS/WARN · `1` BLOCK · `2` usage/error - drop `frai-gate check` straight into CI.
30	
31	`draft` and `--smart` run on the [Claude Agent SDK](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/agent-sdk)
32	with read-only tools (`Read`, `Glob`, `Grep`) and need Claude Code authentication or
33	`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`. Override the model with `FRAI_GATE_MODEL` (default `claude-opus-5`).
34	
35	> **Privacy note:** `draft` and `--smart` send the repository content the agent reads to
36	> Anthropic's API. The agent is instructed never to read secret material (`.env`, keys,
37	> certificates, credential stores), but treat that as a mitigation, not a guarantee -
38	> think before running them on highly sensitive repos. `check` without `--smart` makes
39	> no network calls at all.
40	
41	## Programmatic API
42	
43	```ts
44	import { validateSpec, draftGateSection, smartReview } from 'frai-gate';
45	
46	const result = validateSpec(await fs.readFile('FRAI-SPEC.md', 'utf8'));
47	// { verdict: 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'BLOCK', tier, findings, gateSection }
48	```
49	
50	The companion agent skill lives in
51	[sebuzdugan/frai-skills](https://github.com/sebuzdugan/frai-skills)
52	(`npx skills add sebuzdugan/frai-skills`).

## 1. Overall Directory Structure

```
packages/frai-gate/
├── src/
│   ├── cli.ts                 (CLI entry point)
│   ├── index.ts               (Public exports)
│   ├── gate/
│   │   ├── schema.ts          (Type definitions)
│   │   ├── validate.ts        (Validation logic)
│   │   ├── validate.test.ts   (Tests using vitest)
│   │   └── report.ts          (Report formatting)
│   └── pipeline/
│       └── agent.ts           (Claude Agent SDK integration)
├── dist/                      (Compiled JavaScript)
├── assets/
│   └── rai-spec-template.md   (Template file)
├── package.json
└── README.md
```

## 2. GateResult Type Definition

**Location:** `/private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d11/with/t3-summary-feature/r2/packages/frai-gate/src/gate/schema.ts`

```typescript
export interface GateResult {
  verdict: Verdict;           // 'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'BLOCK'
  tier: RiskTier | null;      // 'prohibited' | 'high' | 'limited' | 'minimal' or null
  findings: Finding[];        // Array of validation findings
  gateSection: string | null; // Raw text of the gate section when found
}
```

Also includes related types:
- `Finding`: `{ checkId: string; severity: 'block' | 'warn'; message: string; source: 'validator' | 'agent' }`
- `Verdict`: `'PASS' | 'WARN' | 'BLOCK'`
- `RiskTier`: `'prohibited' | 'high' | 'limited' | 'minimal'`

## 3. GATE_CHECKS Definition

**Location:** Same file (`gate/schema.ts`)

The package defines **7 gate checks**, each with an ID, title, and regex pattern to match subsection headings:

```typescript
export const GATE_CHECKS: GateCheck[] = [
  { id: 'risk-tier', title: 'Risk tier', headingPattern: /risk|tier/i },
  { id: 'data-privacy', title: 'Data & privacy', headingPattern: /data|privacy|provenance/i },
  { id: 'oversight', title: 'Human oversight', headingPattern: /oversight|human|control/i },
  { id: 'evaluation', title: 'Evaluation plan', headingPattern: /eval/i, expectsNumbers: true },
  { id: 'bias', title: 'Bias & fairness', headingPattern: /bias|fairness/i },
  { id: 'monitoring', title: 'Monitoring & rollback', headingPattern: /monitor|rollback/i, expectsNumbers: true },
  { id: 'transparency', title: 'Transparency & incidents', headingPattern: /transparen|incident|disclosure/i }
];
```

## 4. Report Formatting

**Location:** `/private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d11/with/t3-summary-feature/r2/packages/frai-gate/src/gate/report.ts`

Two rendering functions:
- `renderText(result, specPath)`: Produces human-readable output with emoji icons (✅ ⚠️ ⛔) and formatted findings
- `renderJson(result, specPath)`: Produces machine-readable JSON with verdict, tier, and findings

## 5. CLI Entry Point and Check Command

**Location:** `/private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d11/with/t3-summary-feature/r2/packages/frai-gate/src/cli.ts`

**Three main commands:**

1. **`init`** - Creates FRAI-SPEC.md template and optionally sets up GitHub Action workflow
2. **`check <spec.md>`** - Validates the spec (returns exit code 0=PASS/WARN, 1=BLOCK, 2=error)
   - Supports `--smart` flag for adversarial AI review using Claude Agent SDK
   - Supports `--json` flag for machine-readable output
3. **`draft`** - Uses Claude Agent SDK to scan repo and draft a filled-in gate section
   - Supports `--out <file>` and `--print` flags

The check command flow:
1. Reads markdown file
2. Calls `validateSpec()` to validate structure
3. Optionally calls `smartReview()` if `--smart` flag present
4. Renders output (text or JSON)
5. Returns appropriate exit code based on verdict

## 6. Test Structure

**Location:** `/private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d11/with/t3-summary-feature/r2/packages/frai-gate/src/gate/validate.test.ts`

Uses **Vitest** with 13 test cases covering:
- Missing gate section detection
- Full passing validation
- Empty field detection
- Placeholder text detection
- Missing subsections
- High-risk tier sign-off validation
- Prohibited tier blocking
- Risk tier recognition variants
- Numeric threshold warnings
- Branded "FRAI Gate" heading acceptance

**Key validation rules implemented in `validate.ts`:**
- Detects missing/empty sections
- Flags placeholder text (TBD, TODO, FIXME, XXX, "fill in")
- Extracts and validates risk tier (only one allowed, matches enum)
- Handles high-risk tier sign-off requirements
- Blocks prohibited tier automatically
- Warns when numeric thresholds are missing on evaluation/monitoring checks

The package is built with TypeScript, compiled to JavaScript in `dist/`, and exported via `index.ts` for programmatic use.
